title: Scalar balance of external cup products
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ be structure morphisms of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. For modules $F$ on $X$, $G$ on $Y$, degrees $p,q\geq0$, and the restricted-scalar external cup product [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], one has $a\boxtimes(r b)=(r a)\boxtimes b$ for every $r\in k$, $a\in H_k^p(X,F)$ and $b\in H_k^q(Y,G)$. No assumptions on the structure ring maps or the schemes beyond being over the field are imposed.

proof.text: The cohomology-to-Ext comparison commutes with scalar multiplication by scalarCohomologyExtMap_smul. Exact inverse image on k-vector-space sheaves is k-linear: its right adjoint is sectionwise precomposition, and linearity passes to the left adjoint. Yoneda composition and exact-functor transport on Ext are k-linear. Thus the two projection pullbacks commute with scalar multiplication.

In the defining Yoneda cup formula, tensorLeft and tensorRight are k-linear. The Ext composition identities move a scalar from either argument to the common composite. Injectivity of scalarCohomologyExtEquiv gives balance for scalarCohomologyCup; substitute the linear projection pullbacks in the definition of externalCup.

lean.statement:
theorem external_cup_scalar_balance (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (p q : ℕ) (r : k) (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology g G q) :
    externalCup f g F G p q a (r • b) = externalCup f g F G p q (r • a) b
